description: TWO MODELS TOTAL: Claude Opus 5 versus opencode DeepSeek V4 Pro over 2 rounds (up to 1 extra round on the judge's request), with Opus also acting as judge in a separate fresh session. The cheapest useful roster, and the only one that needs just two model vendors -- reach for it when Codex is unavailable or when the debate transcript matters more than the verdict. The trade-off is explicit: the judge shares Opus's priors with debater 'opus', so it is session-independent but NOT model-independent and may systematically favour that plan. The driver prints that warning on every run. Use rosters/trio.json when the verdict itself is the deliverable and must be defensible. Labels are anonymous so no participant, and not the judge, learns which model wrote which plan.
